parts.name: Foot Pad
parts.Basic_description: The foot pad of the trashcan is a small plastic pedal located at the bottom front of the trashcan.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to open the lid of the trashcan hands-free by pressing it with the foot, activating a lever mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It moves downward when pressed and returns to its original position when released.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a flat, hinged plastic cover that seals the top of the trashcan.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents odors from escaping and opens when the foot pad is pressed or manually lifted.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward around a hinge axis when opened and returns downward to close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the trashcan, typically made of stainless steel for durability and easy cleaning.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the trash bag and provides structural support for the lid and foot pedal mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation.
